crop_policy: one deterministically selected crop per source, retain all queries of that crop; preserve pilot crops; no score or availability selection
checkpoint_selection: highest internal validation full mAP at epochs 10..80, earliest tie; not independent evaluation
availability_policy: no replacements; every frozen crop must pass before feature extraction and training
scope: official-train source-disjoint internal study; frozen CLIP, no pretrained localizer weights, no VLM, no old80/fresh evaluation
